events.text: The New York Cotton Exchange occupied the building starting in 1872.
events.subject: self

events.text: The New York Cotton Exchange's occupancy of the building ended in 1885.
events.subject: self

events.text: The building served as the headquarters of W.R. Grace and Company until the early 1910s.
events.subject: self

events.text: In 1914, the structures were purchased by the India House.
